Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting and Parliamentary Affairs Dr. L. Murugan
is resigned from both his ministries as well as membership of Rajasabha. In a letter to
Prime Minister in Narendra Modi, Dr. Murugan said that from the son of a daily wage labourers
to serving in the Union Council of Ministers, under his leadership has been the greatest
privilege of his life.
Talking to media, Dr. Murugan said in the letter, he has mentioned that he wishes to
return to the grassroots and dedicate full time to strengthening the BJP in Tamil Nadu.
I wrote a letter to Honourable Prime Minister in Narendra Modi that I want to go to
Tamil Nadu. I want to strengthen my party to Tamil Nadu and also I want to prepare the
ground for 29 elections for Tamil Nadu. Two days before our Honourable Prime Minister came
to Tamil Nadu. I saw that people's enthusiasm and people's love and affection towards our
Honourable Prime Minister. So I thought I want to go more work, strengthen our party there."

The PM Gadishakti National Master Plan has completed five years today, marking significant
progress and integrated infrastructure planning and development in the country.
The master plan was launched on this day in 2021 with the aim of transforming India's
infrastructure landscape.
PM Gatishakti has enabled planners to view infrastructure, geographic features, economic
zones and other relevant data together, supporting data-driven planning and decision-making for
infrastructure projects.
We have more from a correspondent.
Over the last five years, PM Gatishakti's national master plan has evolved from an
integrated digital planning platform into a comprehensive geospatial planning ecosystem
supporting infrastructure, economic and social sector development.
It has brought together ministries, states and infrastructure networks through a GIS-based
platform to support integrated planning and project coordination.
Today, the PM Gatishakti digital platform integrated more than 1,800 data layers covering 58 central
ministries and departments and all 36 states and union territories.
The platform has evaluated over 400 infrastructure projects worth approximately over 20 lakh crore
rupees based on PM Gatishakti principles.
PM Gatishakti has established a whole-of-government approach to infrastructure planning by facilitating
coordinated decision-making and strengthening multimodal and last-mile connectivity.
Shiva Rameshwara, Akash Mani News, Delhi.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined
by the mantra of Jan Seva, said Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues.
Guided by this vision for Seva and Su Sarshan, the government has been ceaselessly
working towards achieving the goal of a Vixit Bharat by 2047.
Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming
lives.
Today, in a special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated
into action through initiatives like the GST Council.
Introduced on 1st July 2017, the Goats and Services Tax GST marked a significant milestone
in India's tax reform journey.
By bringing multiple central and state taxes under a unified framework, GST gave
effect to the principle of one nation, one tax, and paved the way for a more integrated
and streamlined taxation system across the country.
Under the next generation GST reforms last year, the GST Council had simplified the earlier
four-tier structure of 5%, 12%, 18%, and 28% into a two-tier structure of 5% and 18%.
Addressing the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi today, Prime Minister Narendra
Modi said that through GST, the government has transformed a complex wave of taxes to
to create a unified national market.
Today, India's confidence is at a very high level.
We are reforming with a clear policy direction.
Through GST, we have changed the complex web of taxes
in the national market.
And we are not stopping here.
India's reform space is advancing rapidly.
For us, reforms are not a compulsion.
Reforms are our conviction.
Addressing media after the 50th GST Council meeting in New Delhi, Union Finance Minister
Nirmala Sita-Rama said that the Council recommended removing arrest powers under GST, raising the
prosecution threshold from 1 crore to 5 crore rupees.
The Council recommended removing arrest powers under GST.
Council recommended raising the prosecution threshold from 1 crore to 5 crores and reducing
the general penalty from 25,000 to rupees 10,000.

after Diwali.

Inder's Anand Kumar Vail Kumar has won the bronze in the 500 meter sprint at the World's
Gate Games 2026 in Asunision Paraguay adding another medal to his expanding collection
on the international speed skating stage. The 23-year-old speed skater from Tamil Nadu
finished on the podium in 40.856 seconds, continuing his incredible run following his
unprecedented accomplishments at the 2025 World Speed Skating Championship.
Veil Kumar had earned bronze in the 500 meters and gold in the 1,000 meters and marathon
in the 2025 Championships as well, making him a two-time world champion.
